tools.name: get_current_user
tools.description: Get the profile of the currently authenticated Amplitude user including name, email, organization role, and account details.

tools.name: get_org_data
tools.description: Get organization overview including apps/projects, current user info, plan details, and usage status. This is the bootstrap data for the Amplitude organization.

tools.name: list_orgs
tools.description: List all Amplitude organizations the current user belongs to. Returns organization IDs and names.

tools.name: list_users
tools.description: List all members of the current Amplitude organization with their roles, email, and profile details.

tools.name: get_personal_space
tools.description: Get the current user's personal space with its contents, permissions, and folder structure.

tools.name: list_spaces
tools.description: List all team spaces in the organization. Spaces are the top-level containers for organizing charts, dashboards, cohorts, and notebooks.

tools.name: search_content
tools.description: Search across all Amplitude content including charts, dashboards, cohorts, notebooks, and nudges. Filter by content type, owner, space, and more. Results are sorted by relevance by default.

tools.name: list_events
tools.description: List event properties for a specific event type in a project/app. Use get_org_data first to find the app ID, then provide the event type name (e.g., '[Amplitude] Element Clicked').

tools.name: get_color_palettes
tools.description: Get all color palettes available in the organization for chart visualization. Includes built-in Amplitude palettes and custom user-created palettes.

tools.name: get_event_volumes
tools.description: Get monthly event ingestion volumes for the organization within a date range. Shows total, ingested, and billed event counts per month.

tools.name: get_mtu_volumes
tools.description: Get monthly tracked user (MTU) volumes for the organization within a date range. Shows total and billed MTU counts per month.

tools.name: get_session_replay_volumes
tools.description: Get monthly session replay volumes for the organization within a date range.

tools.name: get_entitlements
tools.description: Get active entitlements for the organization including analytics, experiment, and session replay quotas with their limits and time ranges.

tools.name: get_report_quota
tools.description: Get the current report quota usage and limits for the organization. Shows how many charts, dashboards, and spaces exist relative to plan limits.

tools.name: check_permissions
tools.description: Check whether the current user has specific RBAC permissions. Common actions include: INVITE_NEW_USERS, VIEW_PROJECT_LIST, UPDATE_COHORT, CREATE_FEATURE_EXPERIMENT, AI_VIEW_GLOBAL_AGENT, AI_CREATE_GLOBAL_AGENT, UPDATE_BILLING_METHOD, READ_ACCESS_EXPERIMENT.
